MB15.title: The tick cache's `exchange` field has never been read by any study, and it is the retail axis
MB15.ev_class: HIGH - a genuinely unread field on an owned 70 M-print instrument

Bryzgalova-Pavlova-Sikorskaya (JF 2023) identify retail options flow through wholesaler routing and find retail is >60% of volume, prefers cheap weeklies at ~12.6% spreads, and loses money.
MB15.data_needed: None new - data/options_ticks, 70,288,482 prints, 3,884 units, 186 symbols, 1,574 dates, 4.721 GB.

O10 measured the harder limit: 0 of 3,870 next-sessions and 0 of 3,870 exit days are cached.
